section.title: Work that taught me something.
section.description: Five projects, each an attempt to make a real problem a little easier. Every card states the problem, what it does and the stack behind it — with screenshots clearly marked until I add them.
section.empty: No projects in this category yet.

items.title: Sports IPTV Backend
items.problem: A sports streaming product needs a dependable backend layer between its content and the client applications people use.
items.does: A backend for a sports IPTV platform, built with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL.

items.title: Advanced Cookies Analyzer
items.problem: Cookies make the modern web work, but they also enable tracking and privacy problems that are difficult to see.
items.does: An M.Sc. thesis project that analyses website cookies, privacy and tracking behaviour — with a Streamlit interface, Pandas and SQLite.

items.title: Web-Based CGPA Calculator
items.problem: Students calculate SGPA and CGPA by hand, then rebuild transcripts manually — slow, repetitive and easy to get wrong.
items.does: A browser-based SGPA/CGPA calculator with transcript generation, built with HTML, Tailwind CSS and JavaScript.

items.title: BashaRent Manager
items.problem: Buildings, flats, tenants, rent, bills, expenses and payments are usually tracked across disconnected spreadsheets and notebooks.
items.does: An Android-focused rental management app that brings those workflows together, built with Node.js, React and TypeScript.

items.title: Blood Bank Management Platform
items.problem: Blood donation coordination gets fragmented when donors, organisations, blood banks and hospitals each work in their own system.
items.does: A role-based platform in development, with dashboards for donors, social organisations, blood banks, hospitals and admins.
